summary: Created the unprivileged helpdesk account on node1. It can run only `sudo /sbin/rc-service sshd restart`; other administrative commands are denied. Configuration and SSH functionality persisted across the required node reboot.
actions_performed: Created helpdesk with its own UID, group, home directory, and shell; it is not a member of wheel or other privileged groups.
Installed a root-owned, mode-0440 sudoers rule allowing only the exact SSH restart command with NOPASSWD.
Validated the sudoers configuration and tested allowed and denied commands.
Restarted node1 exactly once, confirmed its boot ID changed, and verified the account, sudo policy, and SSH service recovered.
Repeated the permitted SSH restart after reboot and confirmed a changed sshd PID and live OpenSSH banner.

evidence.summary: Shows helpdesk UID/GID, home, shell, sole non-administrative group, and persistence after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Allow only SSH service restart through sudo
evidence.summary: Shows the validated exact sudoers rule; authorization succeeds for SSH restart and fails for root id, SSH stop, and another-service restart.
Before and after reboot, helpdesk successfully restarted sshd; listener PIDs changed and SSH returned a live OpenSSH banner.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID b7d110b8-d7bd-4035-9e8e-fb4d2c144ee1, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 0af7178c-3e2b-4620-b9df-48195943bd48, and recovered account, sudo policy, sshd listener, and SSH banner.
